name: Bakunyuu Jukujo ni Nusumareta Boku
original_name: 爆乳熟女に盗まれた僕
source:
I, Yuuta Satou, am a pretty keep-to-myself high school student.
I like reading. I'm an honors student. But I recently screwed up my life.
Out of sheer boredom I tried to steal from the drug store.

I almost succeeded but a long-haired lady caught me at the exit.
She, Mayuka Nakamura, must have been some sort of anti-theft customer or something. She hauled me back in for questioning.

That's how we met. That's where it all began. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/announce/=/product_id/RE173334.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我，佐藤雄太，是一位性格内向的高中生。
我喜欢读书。我是一名荣誉学生。但我最近搞砸了我的生活。
出于纯粹的无聊，我试图从药店偷东西。

我几乎成功了，但一位长发女士在出口抓住了我。
她，中村真由香，肯定是某种防盗顾客之类的。她把我拉回来审问。

我们就是这样认识的。这就是一切开始的地方。
